title: Morbid obesity: high Pplat, safe PL
summary: High pleural pressure at FRC (Ppl0 +7) with an esophageal balloon in place. Plateau pressure looks alarming while the lung itself sees a modest, even negative end-expiratory PL.
objectives: Show that Pplat > 30 can coexist with PL,ei < 20.
Titrate PEEP toward PL,ee ≥ 0 using Pes.
